name: @dr-code/viewer
description: dr-code's canonical React components for code visualization (shiki v3 rendering standard)

scripts.gen:serve: uv run --directory ../../.. python -m dr_code.serve openapi > schemas/serve-openapi.json && openapi-typescript schemas/serve-openapi.json -o src/gen/serve.ts
scripts.gen:humaneval: uv run --directory ../../.. python -m dr_code.schemas humaneval > schemas/humaneval.schema.json && json2ts --input schemas/humaneval.schema.json --output src/gen/humaneval.ts --additionalProperties false
